en: Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by rapture, a state that is neither accompanied by rapture nor wholesome arises by way of root condition … seven.
Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by pleasure, a state that is neither accompanied by pleasure nor wholesome arises by way of root condition … seven.
Dependent on a wholesome state accompanied by equanimity, a state that is neither accompanied by equanimity nor wholesome arises by way of root condition … seven.
In the case of the root condition, there are twenty-one; in the case of the predominance condition, twenty-one …pe… in the case of non-disappearance, twenty-one.
